mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within a quarter suggests an improving labor market, which typically boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates a strong housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods following a sustained increase in HOUST, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals increased economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to the positive economic news.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over a 3-month period, it indicates real economic growth, which typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > CPIAUCSL growth in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between the differential growth and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to the positive economic news.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a potential inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as inflation erodes real returns.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between the interaction of low FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL with negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over a 3-month period signals a contraction in economic activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate a slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
